outcome: duration from induction of labour to vaginal delivery
rate of adding oxytocin for augmentation
cohort: Nulliparous women at term with a singleton, cephalic pregnancy and an unfavourable cervix requiring labour induction.
finding: Both Prostin and Propess are effective cervical ripening agents with similar efficacy and safety, although Propess was associated with a higher vaginal delivery rate and less need for oxytocin augmentation.
mod_finding: Propess administration was associated with a higher vaginal delivery rate and less need for oxytocin augmentation, though the higher vaginal delivery rate was not statistically significant.
